breath.summary: Breath detection looks for the slow alternation of shorter and longer neighboring RR intervals: inhalation usually shortens RR, while exhalation lengthens it.
breath.parameterLink: Min RR delta sets the minimum change between neighboring intervals that counts as a breathing phase shift, while Max RR rejects overly long intervals so pauses and outliers do not distort detection.
breath.rPeakDescription:
R peaks on ECG
R peaks are time markers of heartbeat moments (R1-R3), defined by time or sample index in the raw data.

RR intervals
The distance between neighboring R peaks is measured in milliseconds: this is the RR interval.

BLE data
In a Heart Rate Measurement notification, the rr field contains several accumulated RR intervals between packets (up to 9 by the Bluetooth SIG specification).
breath.minDeltaDescription: Defines the minimum change between neighboring RR intervals that counts as a breathing phase shift. Used by breath detection to filter out minor fluctuations and noise.
breath.maxRrDescription: Defines the maximum allowed duration of a single RR interval. Used by breath detection to reject overly long intervals, pauses, and outliers.

hub.title: Calibration
hub.subtitle: Choose the mini-game for the target state and run it on this same tab.
hub.guideIntro: ThinkGear is not a medical calibration process. Here we build your session-level personal baseline.
hub.guideStabilization: After connection, allow 10-30 seconds for signal stabilization before capture.
hub.guideFit: Headset repositioning, contact changes, or another user will shift the baseline.
hub.guideModes: The three modes collect representative states for attention, relaxation, and drowse.
hub.guideRecommendation: Recalibration before each session is recommended, but not mandatory.

attention.title: Attention calibration
attention.subtitle: Follow natural numbers from 1 upward, starting with a circle and alternating shapes: circle, triangle, circle...
attention.difficultyHint: Choose the operation set and the number scale before starting.
attention.instructionsBody: Several arithmetic expressions are visible at the same time. Keep moving through the sequence without stopping after mistakes.
attention.instructionsRuleOrder: Move through the natural-number sequence from 1 upward: 1, 2, 3, ...
attention.instructionsRuleShape: The first step is always a circle. Then strictly alternate shapes: circle, triangle, circle, triangle. If the same result appears in both shapes, pick only the shape required for the current step.
attention.instructionsRuleTime: Activity duration is set by the Duration field.
attention.finishedSubtitle: The minute is over. Review the result or run the task again.

alphaRelaxation.title: Breathing Light
alphaRelaxation.subtitle: A gentle visual pacer with optional Gnaural audio.
alphaRelaxation.instructionsBody: Keep a soft gaze on the orb and follow its rhythm. The visual pacer remains fully useful even when audio is off.
alphaRelaxation.instructionsRuleBreath: Inhale while the orb expands, exhale slowly while it contracts.
alphaRelaxation.instructionsRuleGaze: Do not count or chase details. A calm, steady gaze is enough.
alphaRelaxation.instructionsRuleAudio: Audio is optional and plays through Gnaural on the same machine. Headphones are needed for binaural effect.

sleepDrowse.subtitle: Audio-only mode: binaural beats in the delta/theta range via Gnaural.
sleepDrowse.finishedSubtitle: The audio session finished successfully. You can repeat it or change duration.
sleepDrowse.instructionsBody: Put on headphones, get comfortable and close your eyes. The screen will dim automatically once the session starts.
sleepDrowse.instructionsRuleHeadphones: Binaural beats only work with headphones, one channel per ear.
sleepDrowse.instructionsRuleQuiet: Reduce ambient noise and pick a comfortable volume in advance.
sleepDrowse.instructionsRuleDim: After start only the timer and a large Stop button remain visible.

deviceControl.connectTimeoutSecDescription: Defines how many seconds the UI waits for a BLE device to connect before marking the attempt as failed. Used during ECG and other BLE sensor connection attempts; it is not applied to EEG over COM.
deviceControl.eegStaleSecDescription: Defines how many seconds without fresh EEG data are allowed before the EEG stream is considered stale. Used by the BodyMonitor runtime: if no new data arrives longer than this interval, EEG is marked as disconnected.
